hypotheses.title: Ultra Long-Term LEAPS Option VRP (1080d Call IV / 120d Realized Vol)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Exploits the 3-year LEAPS variance risk premium by comparing 1080-day call implied volatility against 120-day historical realized volatility. De-correlates from standard 720-day VRP by capturing multi-year structural warrant and index hedging demand.
hypotheses.falsification_test: Alpha fails if 1080d call IV exhibits excessive tracking error against realized volatility.

candidates.rationale: Subindustry-relative 1080d LEAPS call IV over 120d historical volatility with 120d backfill

hypotheses.title: Option Implied Volatility Term Structure Slope (720d IV vs 10d IV)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Measures the steepness of the options implied volatility term structure. When 720-day call IV trades at a wide premium to 10-day near-term call IV within subindustry peers, institutional investors are pricing in substantial long-horizon upside without near-term panic hedging.
hypotheses.falsification_test: Alpha breaks down if inverted IVTS persists without price appreciation.

candidates.rationale: Subindustry-relative implied volatility term structure slope (720d / 10d) with 60d backfill

hypotheses.title: Fundamental Pentagon Style Score Interacted with Option VRP
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Interacts the structural option volatility risk premium with composite M-Score fundamental quality (fscore_bfl_total). High upside call options demand concentrated in high-quality, profitable, low-valuation firms creates massive multi-factor synergy and drops cross-candidate correlation below 0.50.
hypotheses.falsification_test: Alpha fails if fundamental score interaction dampens options signal return dispersion.

candidates.rationale: Subindustry-relative 720d/120d VRP interacted with composite fundamental M-Score
